purpose: Whole-project clean rebuild of the Lean project of release v1.21.0 (adds Paper 13).
result: 3466 of 3466 modules compiled; 3465 of 3466 replayed with leanchecker; the module Research has no constants and was exempted; 0 audit problems. Two passes: see runs.
computer: the author's Windows computer (63 GB of memory, 16 logical CPUs); OpenAI Codex ran its own Lean builds on the same computer during part of the rebuild, in other directories
procedure: New empty output directory; sources copied from the release tree lean/ (Research.lean and Research/, 3468 files, of which 3466 are Lean modules and 2 are Python scripts of Paper 3). After the build their SHA-256 hashes were compared with the release tree: no difference. The directory Comparator/ was not built here; it is unchanged since version 1.13.0, and the CI workflow checks it.
Each module compiled with lean -DautoImplicit=false -DrelaxedAutoImplicit=false, then each module replayed with leanchecker, by the driver build6.py of version 1.16.0. This is not a lake build.

Warnings are recorded and do not fail a module; an error, sorry or non-zero exit code does. The driver reruns a module automatically (up to three times in pass 1, up to five in pass 2) when an attempt ends in a memory or file-read failure rather than a Lean verdict; logs of earlier attempts are kept with the suffix .attemptN. It starts a new Lean process only while enough commit charge (memory reserved by Windows) is free.

In the published logs the local workspace directory is replaced by <workspace>, the directory of the pinned toolchain and packages (ai4math-lean-worker) by <worker> and the Python directory by <python>, Windows line endings of status*.json, plan.json, research-olean-constants.txt and run.log are written as Unix line endings, and the byte-order mark at the start of research-olean-constants.txt is removed; nothing else is changed. run.log is that of the third start of pass 1; the run.log files of the first two starts were empty and are not included.

runs.note: The driver was started at 19:26:13Z with 10 jobs and restarted twice with --retry-failed, which keeps every result already recorded as passed: at 19:29:47Z with up to 16 jobs and a lower free-memory threshold (8 GiB of commit charge), and at 20:03:05Z with a smaller memory reservation per start (3 GiB), to run more modules at once. The Lean runs still going at each restart were stopped and run again; their 10 empty logs are kept (suffix .attempt1, created when these runs started, 19:27-19:29Z and 20:02Z; the runs were stopped at 19:29:47Z and 20:03:05Z). Compile phase until 2026-11-17T01:53:49Z, leanchecker phase from 01:53:50Z to 06:27:01Z. With the commit charge near its limit, and Codex also using the computer, 1112 attempts failed for lack of memory or file access, not because of a proof: 1080 could not read a compiled file (753 compiling, 327 in leanchecker), 23 std::bad_alloc, 8 out of memory, and 1 kernel thread failure described below, and one further empty log at 22:35Z. 382 modules had such a failed compile attempt and 195 such a failed leanchecker attempt; 295 and 166 of them passed when run again automatically in this pass. At the end of pass 1, 87 modules had not compiled (85 could not read a compiled file at their last attempt, 1 std::bad_alloc, 1 the failure below), 627 modules depending on them were skipped, 29 modules had failed leanchecker (could not read a compiled file at their last attempt) and the 713 modules that had not compiled were skipped in the leanchecker phase; status-pass1.json is the status at the end of pass 1. Kernel thread failure: in the one compile attempt of Research.Backfill.Paper4.Proof.TriangleFreeEnumerationParent6P07 (log written 01:15:20Z) the kernel could not create a thread (Windows error 1455, the commit limit was reached), so the `decide` of line 59 failed with a Lean error, and Lean, as it does after an error, listed sorryAx among the axioms of parent_layer. The driver does not rerun an attempt that ends with a Lean error, so this module was rerun only in pass 2. The source file contains no sorry.

Started by a watcher script only after pass 1 had written its end marker (06:27:02Z, seen by the watcher at 06:29:17Z); pass 1 had finished, so the two drivers never ran at the same time. The same driver with --retry-failed and a free-memory threshold of 20 GiB: every module whose compile or leanchecker run was not recorded as passed in status-pass1.json was run again. It compiled the 87 failed and 627 skipped modules (06:29:21Z to 08:00:15Z) and replayed 742 modules with leanchecker (08:00:15Z to 09:17:21Z), every one at the first attempt of this pass. Research.Backfill.Paper4.Proof.TriangleFreeEnumerationParent6P07 compiled with no error and its theorems parent_valid and parent_layer depend exactly on propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound; it then passed leanchecker. Modules that had passed in pass 1 were not rerun, and pass 2 compiled only modules not recorded as compiled in status-pass1.json; none of them is imported, directly or indirectly, by a module that pass 1 had recorded as compiled.

module_Research.how_counted: readModuleData on Research.olean (research-olean-constants.txt in the log archive)
module_Research.consequence: leanchecker has nothing to replay in this module. It was exempted before the run, as for versions 1.15.0 to 1.20.0.

warnings: 97 lines in 15 older modules, the same lines as for version 1.20.0; none in Paper 13.
axioms: every printed axiom list in the final logs is a subset of propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The lists printed for TaskH.case_four, case_five, case_six and case_seven (by Research.TaskH.MainFour, MainFive, MainSix and MainSeven) are each exactly these three axioms.
forbidden_tokens: logs/clean-replay-v1.21.0-forbidden-tokens.log: outside comments, only the intentional sorry statements of the comparator challenge files lean/Comparator/.
lean_errors: Only one attempt ended in a Lean error: the kernel thread failure in pass 1 described above, caused by the operating system and not by the proof. Every other failed attempt was a memory or file-read failure or an empty log, and every module passed in the end. (The 753 compile attempts that could not read a file print `error: failed to read file` at the import line, and the 327 leanchecker attempts print `leanchecker found a problem ... uncaught exception: failed to read file`; neither is a verdict on a proof.)
